```abap
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_MODIFIC_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       Verarbeiten der internen Angaben zu DDIC-Modifikation          *
*       Aufbau der externen Attribute dazu                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FIELD_INT    Dynprofeld intern                             *
*      <--P_DYNP_FIELD   Dynprofeld extern                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_MODIFIC_OUT
             USING    VALUE(P_FIELD_INT) TYPE DYNPRO_FIELD
             CHANGING P_DYNP_FIELD       TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD.

  P_DYNP_FIELD-MODIFIC = ' '.
  IF P_FIELD_INT-FLG1 O FLG1EDT.               "Schablone
    IF P_FIELD_INT-FLG1 O FLG1DDF.             "Dictfeld
      IF P_FIELD_INT-FLG1 O FLG1DDM.           "modifiziert
        P_DYNP_FIELD-MODIFIC = 'X'.
      ELSE.
        P_DYNP_FIELD-MODIFIC = ' '.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.                              "Schluesselwort
    IF P_FIELD_INT-FLG1 O FLG1DDF.             "Dictfeld
      IF P_FIELD_INT-ITYP = '4'.
        P_DYNP_FIELD-MODIFIC = '4'.
      ELSE.
        IF P_FIELD_INT-ITYP = '1'
        OR P_FIELD_INT-ITYP = '2'
        OR P_FIELD_INT-ITYP = '3'.
          IF P_FIELD_INT-FLG1 O FLG1DDM.       "Fix bei Schluesselwort
            P_DYNP_FIELD-MODIFIC = P_FIELD_INT-ITYP.
          ELSE.
            P_DYNP_FIELD-MODIFIC = 'V'.   "variabel
          ENDIF.
        ELSEIF P_FIELD_INT-ITYP = '0'.                    "Erg. Rel 2.2
          IF P_FIELD_INT-FLG1 O FLG1DDM.
            P_DYNP_FIELD-MODIFIC = 'F'.    "fix
          ELSE.                             "darf ab 3.0B nicht mehr
            P_DYNP_FIELD-MODIFIC = 'V'.     "passieren, da durch
```
